design.refused_task_policy: Report the commissioning refusal and do not create a post-hoc route or navigation run.

primary: strict physical goal-success proportion by task and arm
paired within-seed P1-minus-P0 difference in strict success
paired within-seed P1-minus-P0 difference in collision
paired within-seed P1-minus-P0 difference in simulation duration for runs that satisfy evidence integrity
paired within-seed P1-minus-P0 difference in own-time belief-position RMSE
paired within-seed P1-minus-P0 difference in longest accepted-correction gap
secondary: run-level own-time belief median, p95, RMSE and maximum error
run-level own-time fused-correction median, p95 and above-0.25-m fraction
run-level planar NEES median and 95-percent ellipse containment
accepted, rejected and dropped correction counts
camera opportunity, detector-return and admitted-observation counts
path length and final physical goal distance

required: run summary is complete and reports no contact or geometric collision
ground-truth final goal distance is at most 0.35 m
terminal stop is verified and producer quiescence is acknowledged

time_and_reference.held_sample_weighting: first logged occurrence of each distinct estimate timestamp

aggregation.rule: Compute every continuous metric once per run before any task, arm or paired summary.
aggregation.failed_run_continuous_metrics: Report when reference and evidence are valid, but never condition strict-success summaries on continuous-metric availability.
aggregation.missing_or_invalid: Retain as an explicit outcome with a reason; do not replace it with another attempt unless the campaign runner itself selected that attempt before analysis freeze.
aggregation.uncertainty: Report the five paired differences individually, their median and range. With five seeds, do not claim asymptotic significance or general warehouse-wide effects.

comparisons.primary_interpretation: P0 and P1 share the detector, runtime measurements, fusion, estimator, controller, speed, noise and safety geometry. Their selected route differs only through the pre-runtime availability field used during route selection.
comparisons.null_interpretation: The aisle task uses the same selected route in P0 and P1 and is reported separately as an implementation-null comparison.
comparisons.scope: Fixed final warehouse, fixed commissioned cameras and predeclared tasks; no claim of arbitrary-warehouse generalization.

prohibitions: Do not select runs by file recency or an unconstrained directory glob.
Do not remove a run because it failed, collided or weakens the comparison.
Do not pool per-timestep samples as independent replicates.
Do not compare estimates with ground truth at another timestamp.
Do not refit the detector, correction, covariance or availability model from navigation data.
Do not combine the two primary route-choice tasks with the null-route task into one planner-effect estimate.
